knowledge_abstraction.general_principle: Backend implementations may rely on hidden tensor storage assumptions. Invalid memory layouts may cause failures when these assumptions are violated.

risk_dimensions.shape: Boundary matrix dimensions may expose backend-specific corner cases.
risk_dimensions.dtype: Floating point tensor types may trigger backend-specific execution paths.
risk_dimensions.memory: Unusual tensor storage layouts and abnormal memory alignment should be explored.
risk_dimensions.device: CPU backend execution paths should be considered.
risk_dimensions.execution_state: Backend dispatch behavior should be considered.

failure_mechanism.description: The backend assumes specific memory alignment properties but does not correctly handle abnormal tensor storage layouts.

input_exploration: Generate tensors with unusual storage offsets or alignment conditions.
constraint_awareness: Consider tensor storage properties instead of only tensor values.

important_considerations: Memory layout related corner cases may expose hidden backend assumptions.
Consider exploring abnormal tensor storage conditions.
llm_reasoning_guidance.generation_strategy: Generate diverse memory layout variations instead of reproducing the exact historical bug input.
